# Bait Systematics

> Bait Systematics is a software house and digital growth company with offices in Manchester, United Kingdom and Faisalabad, Pakistan. It is the technology company of BAIT International Group, a government-licensed overseas recruitment group (licence HRD/3421/LHR) trusted by employers across the Gulf, Europe and Asia since 1967.

- Website: https://baitsystematics.com
- Founded: 2024
- Founders: Muhammad Hassan (Co-Founder & Director — clients, partnerships, delivery) and Muhammad Adil (Co-Founder & Lead Engineer — engineering)
- Email: info@baitsystematics.com
- Pakistan (head office): 14-Z Commercial Market, Madina Town, Faisalabad 38000 — +92 311 0429799 (WhatsApp) — Mon–Sat 9:00–18:00
- United Kingdom: 20 Marcliffe Drive, Manchester M19 3XD — +44 7405 449846 — Mon–Fri 9:00–15:00
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/bait-systematics/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/baitsystematics

## Services
- Web application development, business websites and e-commerce stores
- Mobile app development (Android, iOS, Flutter)
- SaaS platforms, APIs and integrations, UI/UX design
- AI-powered software and agentic AI systems, CRM and WhatsApp automation
- ERP, inventory management, pharmacy management, POS, school management and recruitment/HR software
- SEO, Google Ads, Facebook & Instagram ads and social media marketing
- Website maintenance, hosting and support

## How they work
- Free 30-minute consultation and a fixed, itemised quote before work starts
- Clients own the code, designs and IP on final payment
- Clients worldwide; direct contact with the founders
